answer.reason: The verses tell of Leah being given to Jacob in place of Rachel and of the sons she bore, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was given to Jacob in the evening in place of her sister Rachel
clauses.quote: he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him

clauses.english: bore Jacob sons after the LORD opened her womb
clauses.quote: he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren

clauses.english: gave her maid Zilpah to Jacob as a wife
clauses.quote: she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife

doubts: Leah's sons are mentioned as being born to her, but the mother-of-Reuben fact is already in the summary, so only the opening of her womb is stated as an event.
